title: Dual-camera HD Night Vision Dash Cam
body_html:
Product information:
Overview:
This 4K HD dash cam is equipped with an ADAS system, supports dual‑front‑and‑rear recording, and features GPS trajectory tracking. Featuring a Sony sensor and a metal housing, it delivers exceptional night‑vision performance, 24‑hour parking monitoring, and a range of safety‑assist functions, providing all‑around protection for your driving.
Specifications:
Resolution: 4K / 1080P / 2K
Lens Configuration: Square rear lens, truck‑style square lens, in‑cab circular lens, Sony 307 metal rear lens
Screen Size: 3.0 inches
Operation: Button control
Key Features: ADAS, GPS module, rear‑view imaging, motion detection, loop recording, parking monitoring, night‑vision enhancement, collision detection, image distortion correction, front‑and‑rear dual recording
Storage Support: 32GB / 64GB / 128GB high‑speed memory cards
Material: Plastic


Packing list:
1 x Dash Cam Main Unit 1 x GPS Module 1 x 24-Hour Parking Monitoring Cable 1 x High-Speed Memory Card (32GB/64GB/128GB optional) 1 x User Manual
